confidence_notes: Argentine peso prices shift monthly with inflation and exchange-rate moves, and these July 2026 figures are extrapolated from general knowledge rather than checked against current listings. Restaurant anchors are the most grounded; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because many quote in USD. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine_glass about 1.3x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The inexpensive meal assumes one main dish with a soft drink and no alcohol. The FX figure comes from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA; I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is a Buenos Aires-specific holistic estimate from general knowledge of local price levels, rolled forward for Argentina's high monthly inflation to July 2026. No price listings or booking sites were consulted.
